evidence.title: Plate IX: 五竹亭 Wuzhu Ting
evidence.excerpt_other: Cinq pavillons en bambou, posés en hémicycle, et ouverts de tous côtés, d'où l'on voit les jets d'eau.
evidence.summary: Five bamboo pavilions set in a half circle, open all round, joined by bamboo galleries. Our model has them in a row (Q15, Q35).

evidence.title: Engraving 9: 五竹亭 Wuzhu Ting
evidence.excerpt_other: It consisted of five pavilions in Chinese style connected by covered walks.
evidence.summary: Faced north towards 方外观. In Malone's time only two lotus pools, the fountain and the wall behind it were left (plate p.149).

evidence.title: Plate VIII: 方外观 Fangwai Guan
evidence.excerpt_other: Sous cet avant-corps est pratiqué un souterrain, dans lequel on pénètre par une porte, accompagnée à droite et à gauche d'une espèce d'œil de bœuf grillé;
evidence.summary: Small building on a terrace, three windows, rusticated pilasters at the ends. Under the projecting terrace a low room with a door and two grilled oeil-de-boeuf, thought to be for coolness. Round stairs at each end. On the left an open octagonal pavilion beyond a canal with a rich bridge.

evidence.title: 西洋楼区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12205, free part
evidence.summary: Report's opening: the strip runs 860 m east-west, up to 300 m wide in the west and 65 m at its narrowest, about 70,000 m2, built 1747-1783. A central axis divides it into about five sections, each with its own north-south axis, thirteen units from 谐奇趣 to 线法墙. Survey results are paywalled.

reconstructions.title: Plan de l'aire du belvedere (Fig. 2 in S603), Jin Xun's drawing
reconstructions.creator: 金勋 Jin Xun
reconstructions.why: S603: Jin Xun, of an architect family that worked on the garden, drew in 1924 plans and elevations of the European palaces, twelve published in Adam 1936. Scale drawings with water pipes, levels and paving; some detail suggests original documents; the rest from site observation and engravings. S603 lists errors.
reconstructions.caveat: A modern reconstruction drawing, not a Qing document.
reconstructions.licence: none stated; S597 gives the author dates 1881-1976 in one place and 1883-1976 in another

reconstructions.title: Fig. 4, Plan d'ensemble (plan de restitution 1985)
reconstructions.creator: Antoine Durand
reconstructions.archive: Mission Palais d'Ete, under Michele Pirazzoli-t'Serstevens
reconstructions.why: Three stages: 1984 plan from Jin Xun's plan fragments in Adam 1936, on the 1:10,000 park plan at 1:500, corrected by site readings and engravings; 1985 plan from a survey of the whole site, with general dimensions and setting of each building; water theatre from a Lei family drawing, Alimoff photo for the west basin of 海晏堂, engravings for planting.
reconstructions.licence: none stated on the Persee page

facts.label: Destroyed
facts.value: Looted and burnt 1860; stone ruins stayed, further damage 1900 and after (S02 pp.142,218)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Copper engraving no. 9 per S02. 5 Chinese-style pavilions linked by covered walks; pool and wall survive; pavilions gone (S02). Bamboo-clad (S06). Round 6 replaced frontage 6.0 m. Round 6 replaced depth 6.0 m.
